text:
jane_marketing: quick sync — thinking of running a combined webinar + free-credit + prompt-pack experiment the week after launch. goal: lift first-week activation and measure 7d retention. who can own flow map and tracking?

sam_growth: i can map tracking. need UTMs and event names. also want a control group (no credit) + 2 credit sizes (starter 50, boost 200).

alex_prod: +1 on cohorts. we should also test ‘promptpack included’ vs ‘promptpack opt-in’ to see lift from templates. can we do canary on 10% traffic?

lina_design: i’ll draft 3 hero images and a webinar slide deck. need the headline and 1-liner for registration page.

jane_marketing: headline draft: "Build with LLMs faster — free prompt templates + live workshop" 1-liner: "Join our 45-min workshop to ship an LLM feature with starter prompts and credits." feedback?

nina_csm: add a bullet for "enterprise constraints & security" — a lot of demo signups will be from platform teams. also want a follow-up sequence for leads that don’t activate.

sam_growth: tagging metrics: utm_campaign=webinar_q2_promptpack, experiment_id=webinar_pp_v1. events: registered, attended, credit_redeemed, first_generation, activated_7d.

jane_marketing: lets standardize the UTM template. use this: `?utm_source=marketing&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=webinar_q2_promptpack&utm_content={variant}`

alex_prod: for routing: attendees who redeem credit route to dedicated onboarding flow (prompt templates & quickstart). non-redeemers get nudged at day 1,3,7. can we set automatic triggers?

sam_growth: yes — set triggers in campaign tool. Routing rule pseudo: ```if credit_redeemed -> tag:promptpack_redeemer -> route:pp_onboarding_flow else -> nurture_sequence```

lina_design: copy suggestions for launch post (thread + short): "Shipping faster with Redwood Inference — join our workshop for free prompt templates and credits to get started. RSVP: <link> :rocket:"

jane_marketing: love it. add a secondary LinkedIn variant with an explicit value prop for platform teams: "Secure, predictable LLM inference for production — see how we optimize cost + latency. Webinar + free prompt-pack."

nina_csm: follow-up drip copy quick idea: Day 1: "Thanks for attending — here’s your prompt pack + quickstart" Day 3: "See these example prompts that drove 30% faster iteration" Day 7: "Need help integrating? Book an onboarding slot"

sam_growth: A/B plan: Variant A: 50 credits + promptpack (n=500) Variant B: 200 credits + promptpack (n=500) Variant C: promptpack only (n=500) plus control natpop. KPIs: activation rate (7d), cost-per-activated, avg generations/week.

alex_prod: experiment length: 21 days post-registration to capture early retention. need metric baseline from last webinar (jane?)

jane_marketing: baseline: last webinar activation 8% at 7d, avg gens/week 3. target: +4pp activation and +1 gen/week.

lina_design: timeline: assets ready by Wed (design), registration page live Fri, promo cadence Mon-Fri following week, webinar Wed.

nina_csm: i’ll prep 3 short customer anecdotes for the webinar and a troubleshooting FAQ for onboarding.

sam_growth: analytics: make sure we tag by `experiment_id` and propagate through to backend events. will give query templates tomorrow.

jane_marketing: action items: sam - tracking & segmentation; alex - onboarding flow routing; lina - assets & hero copy; nina - webinar anecdotes + follow-up sequences; me - promo calendar + launch posts.

webinar-bot: Reminder scheduled: Registration page goes live Fri 09:00 UTC. Auto-reminder for registrants 24h before event.

alex_prod: one last ask — can we sketch the benchmark narrative for the internal launch doc? need a one-paragraph summary of hypothesis, method, expected lift and rollback plan.

jane_marketing: draft benchmark narrative: "Hypothesis: combining a low-friction webinar with immediate credit incentives and tailored prompt templates will increase short-term activation and reduce time-to-value. Method: randomized A/B experiment across three variants (credit sizes + promptpack) with instrumentation for redemption and subsequent activity; routing to a tailored onboarding flow for redeemers. Expected lift: +4 percentage points in 7-day activation and a 25% increase in average weekly generations for redeemers. Rollback: if activation or usage decreases vs control at 21 days, pause credit spend and revert routing to baseline nurture sequence."

sam_growth: solid. i’ll add power calc and required sample sizes to the doc.

jane_marketing: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll open the experiment doc and post link once created. :thumbsup:
